scenarioSet.description: Named synthetic one-target score and gate diagnostics for cbrn_protect_hospitals_and_utilities. ENG/state 16 is a fixture binding, not a live campaign target or complete national target pool. A population of 1000 yields source-calculated quoted values of 30 masks and 20 support under current constants; hospital PP is 10. Exact-alert cases explicitly supply those normal state quote variables as hypothetical registration output. Clean/contamination-only baseline cases omit them because the current dormant alert writer is the only active source; this keeps the existing missing-writer condition visible. The adapter reports AI willingness scores only and does not normalize them to a decision-selection probability.

scenarios.label: Synthetic ENG/state 16; no raid alert, zero chemical contamination, and no quote costs registered in this baseline; population below the high-population AI threshold.

Synthetic pre-repair alert registration: alert flag present, contamination zero, quote variables derived at 1000 population (mask 30, support 20). The alert itself has no active production event writer in this baseline.
Synthetic state with positive chemical contamination but no raid-alert flag and no quote variables registered; tests the accepted contamination relevance path against the strict-alert baseline.
Synthetic alert and positive contamination together, with the same 1000-population quote values.
Synthetic alert target with the duplicate hospital-secured flag already set and quote values present.
Synthetic state owned by ENG but controlled by FRA; alert flag and quote values present, so only the target-controller gate differs.
Synthetic alert target with quote 10 PP, 30 masks and 20 support; all three resource stocks are one below the quote.
Synthetic alert target with exact quote resources: 10 PP, 30 masks and 20 support.
Synthetic alert target with each quoted resource one above the requirement: 11 PP, 31 masks and 21 support.
